title: opod-io/opod-core
summary: Self-hosted AI gateway for the GPUs you already own: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint across many machines. Engine-agnostic (Ollama, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, MLX-LM), load-aware routing, one model sharded across nodes, API keys, Prometheus + OpenTelemetry. Go, Apache-2.0, no telemetry.

title: opod-io/opod-sdk
summary: Go SDK for Opod: the typed contract between an opod inference leader and whatever manages it. /admin/v1 wire types, the leader-worker node protocol, the environment contract and the open-weight model catalog as YAML. Standard library only, additive within a contract version. Apache-2.0.

title: Skare69/clipshelf
